math_steps.explanation: $$\begin{gathered}x<0\Rightarrow -x>0\\f(-x)=2(-x)^{2}-(-x)=2 x^{2} + x\\f(x)=-f(-x)=-\left(2 x^{2} + x\right)=- 2 x^{2} - x\\f(0)=0\\\left.\left(- 2 x^{2} - x\right)\right|_{x=0}=0\\x\le 0\text{ 时，}f(x)=- 2 x^{2} - x\end{gathered}$$
